_access_checks.denials_explained: CCPA §7222(f): denials of verified access requests are not explained, or partial denials withhold the disclosable remainder
_access_checks.easy_methods_no_dark_patterns: CCPA §7222(d): methods to request access to ADMT are not easy to use or use dark patterns
_access_checks.logic_explained: CCPA §7222(b)(2): access response does not explain the ADMT logic — how the consumer's personal information produced the output, the parameters and the specific output
_access_checks.non_retaliation_and_rights_instructions: CCPA §7222(b)(4): access response lacks the non-retaliation statement and direct instructions/links for exercising other CCPA rights
_access_checks.outcome_and_human_role_explained: CCPA §7222(b)(3): access response does not explain the outcome — whether the output was the sole factor, the other factors, the human's role, and any planned future use of the output
_access_checks.secure_transmission: CCPA §7222(g): requested information is not transmitted with reasonable security measures
_access_checks.service_provider_assistance: CCPA §7222(i): service providers and contractors do not assist with access-to-ADMT requests
_access_checks.specific_purpose_explained: CCPA §7222(b)(1): access response does not state the specific purpose for which ADMT was used for the consumer
_access_checks.verification_per_article_5: CCPA §7222(e): access requests are not verified per Article 5, or unverifiable requestors are not told so

_assessment_exception_checks.used_solely_for_stated_purpose: CCPA §7221(b)(2)-(3): exception claimed but the ADMT is not used solely for the assessment of ability to perform (admission/hiring) or solely for work allocation/compensation
_assessment_exception_checks.works_for_purpose_without_unlawful_discr: CCPA §7221(b)(2)(B)/(3)(B): exception claimed without evidence that the ADMT works for its purpose and does not unlawfully discriminate on protected characteristics

_human_appeal_checks.appeal_method_clear_and_easy: CCPA §7221(b)(1)(B): human-appeal exception claimed but the appeal method is not clearly described, easy, minimal-step, and compliant with §§7003, 7004, 7021 and Article 5 verification
_human_appeal_checks.reviewer_designated_with_authority_to_ov: CCPA §7221(b)(1)(A): human-appeal exception claimed but no designated human reviewer who understands the ADMT output, considers the consumer's information and has authority to change the decision

_notice_checks.access_right_and_method_described: CCPA §7220(c)(3): Pre-use Notice does not describe the right to access ADMT and how to submit the request
_notice_checks.at_or_before_collection: CCPA §7220(b)(2): Pre-use Notice not presented prominently at or before collection of the personal information the ADMT will process (or before repurposing already-collected data)
_notice_checks.how_it_works_explained: CCPA §7220(c)(5): Pre-use Notice lacks the plain-language explanation of how the ADMT processes personal information (categories that affect the output), the type of output and how it is used (sole factor, other factors, human role), and the alternative process for consumers who opt out
_notice_checks.in_primary_interaction_manner: CCPA §7220(b)(3): Pre-use Notice not presented in the manner in which the business primarily interacts with the consumer
_notice_checks.non_retaliation_stated: CCPA §7220(c)(4): Pre-use Notice does not state that the business is prohibited from retaliating for exercising CCPA rights
_notice_checks.opt_out_right_and_method_described: CCPA §7220(c)(2): Pre-use Notice does not describe the right to opt out of ADMT and how to submit the request (or, under an exception, the appeal route or the exception relied on)
_notice_checks.provided: CCPA §7220(a): no Pre-use Notice informing consumers of the ADMT use and of their rights to opt out of and access ADMT
_notice_checks.specific_purpose_stated: CCPA §7220(c)(1): Pre-use Notice does not give a plain-language, specific purpose for the ADMT (generic 'to make a significant decision' is not permitted)

_opt_out_checks.authorized_agents_accepted: CCPA §7221(j): opt-out requests from authorized agents with the consumer's signed permission are not accepted
_opt_out_checks.ceases_within_15_business_days: CCPA §7221(n)(1): after a post-initiation opt-out, processing with the ADMT does not cease within 15 business days
_opt_out_checks.confirmation_provided: CCPA §7221(h): no means for the consumer to confirm the opt-out was processed
_opt_out_checks.easy_minimal_steps_no_dark_patterns: CCPA §7221(d): opt-out method is not easy to execute with minimal steps and §7004 compliance (no dark patterns)
_opt_out_checks.fraud_denials_explained: CCPA §7221(g): opt-out requests denied as fraudulent without a documented good-faith belief and an explanation to the requestor
_opt_out_checks.no_account_or_extra_information_required: CCPA §7221(e): opt-out requires creating an account or information beyond what is needed to direct the opt-out
_opt_out_checks.no_retaliation: CCPA §7221(l): consumers who opt out are retaliated against (Civ. Code §1798.125, Article 7)
_opt_out_checks.no_verification_required: CCPA §7221(f): opt-out is treated as a verifiable consumer request — verification must not be required
_opt_out_checks.not_cookie_banner_only: CCPA §7221(c)(4): a cookie banner or cookie controls is the only opt-out mechanism — not acceptable, the method must be specific to ADMT
_opt_out_checks.offered: CCPA §7221(a): consumers are not given the ability to opt out of ADMT for significant decisions and no §7221(b) exception is claimed
_opt_out_checks.online_form_via_named_link: CCPA §7221(c)(1): online business does not offer an interactive opt-out form reachable from a link in the Pre-use Notice whose title says what is being opted out of (e.g. 'Opt-out of Automated Decisionmaking Technology')
_opt_out_checks.pre_processing_opt_out_honored: CCPA §7221(m): processing with the ADMT is initiated despite an opt-out received before processing began
_opt_out_checks.service_providers_notified: CCPA §7221(n)(2): service providers, contractors and other recipients are not notified of the opt-out and instructed to comply within the same timeframe
_opt_out_checks.single_opt_out_of_all_offered: CCPA §7221(i): granular choices offered without a single option to opt out of all ADMT uses
_opt_out_checks.twelve_month_wait_before_reconsent: CCPA §7221(k): business re-asks opted-out consumers for consent within 12 months of the opt-out
_opt_out_checks.two_or_more_methods: CCPA §7221(c): fewer than two designated opt-out methods, or none reflects how the business primarily interacts with consumers

_report_checks.benefits_specific: CCPA §7152(a)(4): benefits to the business, consumer, stakeholders and public not identified specifically
_report_checks.categories_and_minimum_pi_identified: CCPA §7152(a)(2): categories of personal information (including sensitive PI) and the minimum PI necessary for the purpose not documented
_report_checks.contributors_identified: CCPA §7152(a)(8): individuals who provided information for the assessment not identified (legal counsel excepted)
_report_checks.decision_to_initiate_documented: CCPA §7152(a)(7): whether the business will initiate the processing not documented
_report_checks.negative_impacts_with_sources: CCPA §7152(a)(5): negative impacts to consumers' privacy, with their sources and causes, not identified (security, discrimination, loss of control, coercion, economic, physical, reputational, psychological harms)
_report_checks.operational_elements_documented: CCPA §7152(a)(3): operational elements not documented — collection/use/disclosure/retention method and sources, retention periods or criteria, consumer interaction method and purpose, approximate consumer count, disclosures made, and recipients with purposes
_report_checks.purpose_specific_not_generic: CCPA §7152(a)(1): purpose of processing not identified specifically (generic purposes such as 'to improve our services' are not permitted)
_report_checks.reviewed_and_approved_by_decision_author: CCPA §7152(a)(9): review/approval date and the names and positions of reviewers not documented, or the approver lacks authority to decide whether the processing proceeds
_report_checks.safeguards_documented: CCPA §7152(a)(6): safeguards planned for the processing (and for each identified negative impact) not documented

_submission_checks.includes_required_contents: CCPA §7157(b): submission lacks required contents — business name and contact, period covered, count of assessments per §7150(b) activity, categories of PI/sensitive PI involved, penalty-of-perjury attestation, submitter name/title/date
_submission_checks.reports_available_within_30_days_of_requ: CCPA §7157(e): business cannot produce full risk assessment reports within 30 calendar days of an Agency or Attorney General request
_submission_checks.submitted_by_april_1: CCPA §7157(a): risk assessment information not submitted to the Agency by April 1 following the assessment year (2028-04-01 for 2026–2027 assessments)
_submission_checks.submitted_by_responsible_executive: CCPA §7157(c): submission not made by an executive directly responsible for risk-assessment compliance with sufficient knowledge and authority

_timing_checks.retained_five_years_or_duration_of_proce: CCPA §7155(c): risk assessments (original and updated) not retained for the duration of processing or five years after completion, whichever is later
_timing_checks.reviewed_at_least_every_three_years: CCPA §7155(a)(2): risk assessments not reviewed and updated at least once every three years
_timing_checks.updated_within_45_days_of_material_chang: CCPA §7155(a)(3): risk assessments not updated within 45 calendar days of a material change (new or larger negative impacts, weakened safeguards)
